scripts.dev:packs: concurrently -n hover,juice "cd corpan/packs/hover-runner && npm run dev:watch" "cd corpan/packs/juice-squeeze && npm run dev:watch"
scripts.build: npm run build:io && npm run build:pages && npm run build:packs
scripts.build:packs: npm run build:hover-runner && npm run build:juice-squeeze && npm run package:packs && npm run copy:packs
scripts.package:packs: npm run package:hover-runner && npm run package:juice-squeeze && npm run package:hanzipan
scripts.package:hover-runner: cd corpan/packs/hover-runner && zip -r hover-runner.zip manifest.json dist/
scripts.package:juice-squeeze: cd corpan/packs/juice-squeeze && zip -r juice-squeeze.zip manifest.json dist/
scripts.package:hanzipan: cd corpan/packs/hanzipan && mkdir -p dist && cat hanziwriter.min.js > dist/app.js && printf '\n;' >> dist/app.js && cat index.js >> dist/app.js && cp styles.css dist/app.css && zip -r hanzipan.zip manifest.json dist/ HANZIWRITER_LICENSE.txt data/
scripts.copy:packs: npm run copy:hover-runner && npm run copy:juice-squeeze && npm run copy:hanzipan
scripts.copy:hover-runner: mkdir -p web/io/out/corpan/packs/hover-runner && cp corpan/packs/hover-runner/manifest.json web/io/out/corpan/packs/hover-runner/ && cp -R corpan/packs/hover-runner/dist web/io/out/corpan/packs/hover-runner/ && cp corpan/packs/hover-runner/hover-runner.zip web/io/out/corpan/packs/
scripts.copy:juice-squeeze: mkdir -p web/io/out/corpan/packs/juice-squeeze && cp corpan/packs/juice-squeeze/manifest.json web/io/out/corpan/packs/juice-squeeze/ && cp -R corpan/packs/juice-squeeze/dist web/io/out/corpan/packs/juice-squeeze/ && cp corpan/packs/juice-squeeze/juice-squeeze.zip web/io/out/corpan/packs/
scripts.copy:hanzipan: mkdir -p web/io/out/corpan/packs/hanzipan && cp corpan/packs/hanzipan/manifest.json web/io/out/corpan/packs/hanzipan/ && cp -R corpan/packs/hanzipan/dist web/io/out/corpan/packs/hanzipan/ && cp -R corpan/packs/hanzipan/data web/io/out/corpan/packs/hanzipan/ && cp corpan/packs/hanzipan/hanzipan.zip web/io/out/corpan/packs/
